passion.title: A Passion for Healthcare
passion.body: Spiber Med is an established Bangladesh-based medical and surgical equipment company with global connections, focused on bringing health technology to improve care for more patients. Today Spiber Med offers a “Total Solution” across healthcare design, equipment, service, and support — introducing compliance, efficiency, and innovation to your medical facility. Spiber Med is also a one-stop platform for efficient training of healthcare and allied professionals, expert consultation for maintaining modern hospitals, and global employment support for healthcare professionals.

encounter.title: Experience That Makes a Difference
encounter.body: Our extensive experience in healthcare has given us a deep understanding of how hospitals, clinicians, and equipment work together. We have seen the razor-thin line between life and death many times — which is why we are meticulous about how our equipment functions and is designed: every second matters. Our solutions keep your investment safe and sound, and we keep pace with the market.
points: Deep clinical understanding and real-world insight
Fast, reliable response when it matters most
Built on trust, guided by purpose

slides.title: Collaborating with Clients Around the World to Develop and Use Science and Technology to Address Societal Issues
paragraphs: Spiber Med has been built, from its founding, on a single corporate philosophy: implementing science and technology to improve society and empower healthcare.

We provide analytical medical and surgical equipment used across many healthcare sectors — for health assessment, diagnosis, and treatment — contributing to patient safety and to the convenience of life through our customers’ experience.

Despite our limitations, I believe we have kept giving back to society because we have always risen to the challenge of solving the problems our clients face. The pace at which society is changing today is unprecedented, and we are dedicated to addressing these issues with fresh vigour — in the face of an unending stream of new difficulties such as the pandemic, global warming, declining birth rates, and ageing populations.

Spiber Med is a one-stop solution for healthcare, committed to strengthening the healthcare system. Beyond medical and surgical equipment, we steadily focus on the continuous professional development (CPD) of healthcare professionals. Our philosophy — implementing science and technology to improve society and empower healthcare — genuinely expresses that goal.
Spiber Med will keep elevating itself by building on the knowledge and technology passed down to us. You can anticipate even more remarkable things from Spiber Med in the future.

hero.description: Entering a new era of data-powered, human-centred healthcare — shaping the way forward for people and care in a constantly changing medical environment.

intro.title: Shaping the Future of Healthcare
paragraphs: Spiber Med is about to undergo a significant transition. We are entering a new era in the use of cutting-edge technology to combat illness and promote health. The Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) were created to address social problems that extend beyond national boundaries.

There are numerous problems with healthcare today — including disparities in access to primary care, ageing populations and rising medical costs in developed nations, and insufficient primary care in developing nations.

With cutting-edge digital technology powered by data, and our core competency in human-machine interface technology, Spiber Med will be able to provide innovative solutions that fulfil the ideal care cycle for every patient.

There is also a significant scarcity of appropriately skilled healthcare professionals in Bangladesh. Our aim is to properly develop their skills and arrange better employment — both nationally and internationally.

Guided by the principles we have maintained since our founding, we will work to become the designer that frames the way forward for people and healthcare — in a medical environment that is always changing.
With a great deal of passion, we have developed our long-term vision: Design the Future, 2040.

compass.title: Our New Value Creation Model
compass.body: In collaboration with international partners, Spiber Med will provide cutting-edge technology and meaningful medical and surgical solutions that address problems at clinical sites. As we move closer to 2040, our new value-creation model is called the Value Creation Compass.

items.title: Patient Outcomes & Healthcare Costs
items.body: We add value to healthcare by addressing global issues related to improving patient outcomes and the financial viability of medical care.

items.title: Appropriate Remedies for Every Illness & Location
items.body: We offer every patient the best possible care-cycle solution — including home care, diagnosis, and treatment.

items.title: Medical Equipment & Cutting-Edge Technology
items.body: We deal in cutting-edge, technology-based medical and surgical equipment, crucial for patient interaction at every stage of the clinical process.

items.title: Value from Clinical-Site Information
items.body: We build a platform for data integration and innovate algorithms — combining vital signs, IoT, EMR-OPD, EMR-IPD, and HIMS data, with analytics and AI driving clinical prediction models.

items.title: Skill Development & Training
items.body: We are establishing a CPD provider training platform in Bangladesh — with a highly accredited LMS and international trainers — giving young professionals access to learning resources, journals, seminars, webinars, hands-on training, and certification.

transformations.title: Our Company-Wide Management Policy
transformations.body: Over the coming years, Spiber Med has set four transformations to be implemented as a company-wide management policy.

items.title: Become a Multinational Business Hub with Significant Added Value
items.body: Encourage international business plans that prioritise rapid expansion and profitability, create complex value propositions, foster new domestic business sectors, and use our global network to develop new business models.

items.title: A Solution Company That Offers Outstanding Value
items.body: Develop business plans that address medical problems, and a value-creation model that leverages expertise in artificial intelligence to produce value from data and disease prediction.

items.title: A Multinational Company Built on Operational Excellence
items.body: Create governance and an organisational structure consistent with our business plan, establish a global supply-chain-based development, production, and sales system, and build an Excellence Centre to deploy global business.

items.title: A 360° Advanced Centre of Excellence for Skill Development & Training
items.body: Keep patients in good health and safety, ensure Training-of-Trainers (TOT) programmes, and create a centre of excellence for doctors, nurses, technicians, and administrators.
